## Project Overview

Clean up the following variables:

*  `A_1ry`: [bin] any events                              by CSPS-month
*  `A_2ry`: [cat] no (0), local (1), distant (2) events   by CSPS-month
*  `A_3ry`: [bin] any political viol, demo, strategic dev by CSPS-month
*  `A_3ry`: [bin] any non-/violent events                 by CSPS-month

### 0. Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config, show=F, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("analysis/0-config.R"))

############################
# Village id and names
############################
vill_codes_names <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"vill_codes_names.csv"))

############################
# CSPS id, name, village
############################
csps_codes <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"csps_codes.csv"))

############################
# CSPS geodata + visit data
############################
vill_csps_gps <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"vill_csps_gps.csv"), 
           col_types = cols(csps = col_integer(), 
                            village = col_integer()))

############################
# CSPS GPS data only
############################
csps_gps <- 
  vill_csps_gps %>%
  dplyr::select(c(csps,csps_lat_new,csps_lon_new)) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(csps)) %>%
  rename(csps_lat = csps_lat_new,
         csps_lon = csps_lon_new) %>%
  arrange(csps)

write_csv(csps_gps, paste0(temp_data_path, "csps_gps.csv"))

############################
# ACLED event data
############################
acled_data <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"ACLED_2020-02-01-2023-04-01-Burkina_Faso v2.csv"))

############################
# File 01A data
############################
df_01A_all <- read_csv(paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_all.csv"))
df_01A_mal <- read_csv(paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_mal.csv"))
df_01A_pne <- read_csv(paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_pne.csv"))
df_01A_dia <- read_csv(paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_dia.csv"))


```

### 1. Prepare event data for exposure variable operationalization.
```{r prep-df, warning=F, message=F}
#################################
# Format id + date vars. 
# Include Kossi Province only.
#################################
acled_01B_details <- 
  acled_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(admin2 %in% c("Kossi")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(event_date, format = "%d %B %Y")) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>%
  relocate(date, .after=event_date) %>%
  relocate(month, .after=year) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(id_event = row_number()) %>%       # Add row ids
  relocate(id_event, .before = "event_id_cnty")
  
#################################
# Extract GPS and date data
#################################
acled_01B_gps <-
  acled_01B_details %>%
  dplyr::select(c(id_event,year,month,longitude,latitude))

write_rds(acled_01B_gps, paste0(temp_data_path,"df_violence.rds")) # Save
write_csv(acled_01B_gps, paste0(temp_data_path,"df_violence.csv")) # Save

```


### 2A. Calculate distance of every event from every CSPS.
```{r dist-recipe, warning=F, message=F}
#################################
# Calculate dist between every
# event and csps (in meters)
#################################
for (hf in csps_gps$csps){
  
  events_01B_recipe <- 
    recipe(~., data = acled_01B_gps) %>%
    update_role(id_event, new_role = "location") %>%
    step_geodist(
      lat = latitude, 
      lon = longitude, 
      log = FALSE,
      ref_lat = csps_gps$csps_lat[csps_gps$csps==hf], 
      ref_lon = csps_gps$csps_lon[csps_gps$csps==hf],
      is_lat_lon = TRUE
      ) %>%
    prep(training = acled_01B_gps)
  
  dist_col <- paste0("dist_csps_", hf)
  
  acled_01B_gps <- 
    bake(events_01B_recipe, new_data = NULL) %>%
    mutate(geo_dist = round(geo_dist / 1000, digits = 1)) %>%   # meters to km
    rename(!!dist_col := geo_dist)
  
  colnames(acled_01B_gps)[ncol(acled_01B_gps)] <- paste0("dist_csps_",hf)
  
}

#################################
# Merge with ACLED details
#################################
events_01B_merged <- 
  bake(events_01B_recipe, new_data = NULL) %>% # Convert to df
  left_join(acled_01B_details %>% dplyr::select(c(1,2,8:10,21:25,29:32)), 
            by = "id_event") %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of("geo_dist"))
  
colnames(acled_01B_details)
colnames(events_01B_merged)

```


### 2B. Calculate max distance from household to CSPS. 
This will define radius within which an event is considered local to the CSPS.
```{r calc-distance, warning=F, message=F}

#################################

mean(vill_csps_gps$dist_csps)   # 4.97 km

median(vill_csps_gps$dist_csps) # 4.95 km
quantile(vill_csps_gps$dist_csps, probs=seq(0,1,0.1))

hist(vill_csps_gps$dist_csps, breaks = 28)

# Set "local" radius = 20 km
#################################

```


### 3. Define exposure variables:

- 1ry: [bin] any events                              by CSPS-month
- 2ry: [cat] no (0), local (1), distant (2) events   by CSPS-month
- 3ry: [int] number of fatalities                    by CSPS-month
- 3ry: [bin] any political viol, demo, strategic dev by CSPS-month
- 3ry: [bin] any non-/violent events                 by CSPS-month
    - violent if 
     - disorder_type  == "Political violence" or 
     - sub_event_type == "Violent demonstration")

#### 3A. Transform dataset.
```{r prep-data}
#################################
# Transform wide-to-long
#################################
events_01B_long <- 
  events_01B_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("dist_csps_"),
    names_to        = "csps",
    names_prefix    = "dist_csps_",
    names_transform = as.integer,
    values_to       = "dist_km"
  ) %>%
  relocate(csps, .after = "id_event") %>%
  mutate(
    is_loc = dist_km <= 20,
    is_pol = grepl("Political violence",     disorder_type, fixed = TRUE),
    is_dem = grepl("Demonstrations",         disorder_type, fixed = TRUE),
    is_str = grepl("Strategic developments", disorder_type, fixed = TRUE),
    is_vio = (is_pol) | (sub_event_type %in% "Violent demonstration")
  )

#################################
# Aggregate to CSPS-month +
# generate exposure variables
# Note: Only mos w/ 1+ event appear.
# Will need to 
# - add "None" for event_loc
# - add zeros to remaining vars
#################################
events_01B_variables <- 
  events_01B_long %>%
  group_by(csps, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    # Count and binary indicators (overall)
    event_tot = n(),
    event_any = as.integer(event_tot>0),
    
    # Binary indicators by violence type and proximity
    event_any_loc = ifelse(any(is_loc), as.integer(1), as.integer(2)),
    event_any_vio = ifelse(any(is_vio), as.integer(1), as.integer(2)),
    event_any_pol = as.integer(any(is_pol)),
    event_any_dem = as.integer(any(is_dem)),
    event_any_str = as.integer(any(is_str)),
    # event_any_loc_vio = (is_loc * is_vio),
    
    # Count indicators by violence type and proximity
    event_tot_fat = as.integer(sum(fatalities, na.rm = T)),
    event_tot_loc = sum(is_loc, na.rm = T),
    event_tot_pol = sum(is_pol, na.rm = T),
    event_tot_dem = sum(is_dem, na.rm = T),
    event_tot_str = sum(is_str, na.rm = T),
    event_tot_vio = sum(is_vio, na.rm = T),
    # event_tot_loc_vio = sum(event_any_loc_vio, na.rm = T),
    event_min_dist = min(dist_km, na.rm = T),
    event_max_dist = max(dist_km, na.rm = T)
    ) %>% ungroup()

events_01B_variables

#################################
# Create event_any_prior for
# cumulative exposure variable
#################################
events_01B_prior <-
  events_01B_variables %>%
  mutate(event_date = make_date(year, month, 1)) %>%
  dplyr::select(csps, event_date, event_any) %>%
  rename(event_any_prior = event_any)

events_01B_prior

```

                         df_01A_mal,

# Loop through all outcome dfs
